notes: Parrot club offering a Parrot Placement Program (a REFERRAL/liaison service - the bird stays in its home or a LIPS foster while LIPS matches a pre-screened member/adopter; membership required to adopt; one adoption per 6 months). Placement area explicitly includes Long Island, Queens, Brooklyn, Bronx, Staten Island, NYC, lower Westchester & lower Rockland. Species-based referral fees paid only on a successful adoption: ~$12 budgies/lovebirds; $42 conures/quakers/cockatiels; $52 Senegal/ringneck/Pionus; $152 greys/amazons/cockatoos/macaws/eclectus; $252 rare macaws. Also maintains NYC-relevant resource pages: avian vets, behavior consultants, groomers, pet sitters, lost-found, bereavement, emergency numbers. (An earlier 2026 suspension was lifted - program verified active on the last-verified date.) Placement contact (631) 456-1813.
